message: a way to land on it
$reason: `wrapper-with-a-bound-stop-and-no-role` with the stop written, `tabindex="-1"`: the half of point 9's reading its bound twin does not hold. axe looks through a role-less element unless it carries a global ARIA attribute or takes focus, so the wrapper owns the option and a listbox may not own it. The tag scan's literal key read this one too; a point 9 that asked for the bound key alone would pass it.
